title: Oil Reservoir Management Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
Oil Reservoir Management Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Please note that this role is based in Saudi Arabia on a permanent, residential basis.

Overview

We are seeking an Oil Reservoir Management Engineer with extensive experience in Oil Reservoir Management to join our Exploration and Petroleum Engineering Center in Dhahran. Our Center provides expert advice and guidance on all aspects of oil reservoir management, including designing, participating in and implementing best‑in‑class reservoir management programs. This position is embedded within the Petroleum Engineering business and as a senior technical specialist, you will engage with leaders and experts from across the upstream business.

Your primary role is to manage some of the world’s largest onshore and offshore oil fields, conduct pioneering research, introduce new technologies and provide specialized engineering services as part of the customized reservoir management practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide guidance and oversight on best-in-class reservoir management tenets, practices and state of the art technologies for all Saudi Aramco hydrocarbon assets.
  • Formulate reservoir development, data acquisition, strategic surveillance and monitoring master-plans to ensure optimal development and depletion strategies.
  • Utilize reservoir management standards and guidelines to enhance both net present value and hydrocarbon recovery.
  • Lead, design and participate in integrated field reviews and field development plans.
  • Prepare reservoir engineering input into drilling and work-over proposals and programs.
  • Recommend advanced completion techniques for horizontal and multi-lateral wells.
  • Lead and participate in reservoir engineering studies that include reservoir stimulation modeling of various International Offshore Rule (IOR) processes for improvement of ultimate recovery.
  • Participate in technical societies and technical groups.

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor degree in Petroleum Engineering or related discipline. A Master degree or PhD is desirable, but not required.
  • Have a minimum of 10 years related experience including at least 7 years specializing in oil reservoir management. A training history of appropriate specialized courses and seminars is expected. Technical publications are valued but in‑depth practical experience is paramount.
  • Must have full professional proficiency in English required to interact and communicate clearly with specialists in geology, core and fluid analysis, petrophysics, simulation, drilling, completion, production and facilities.
  • Must have working knowledge of open‑hole and cased‑hole logs, geological modeling, simulation, completion and production procedures and technologies.
  • Technical knowledge and expertise are required in formation evaluation, geological modeling, simulation, reservoir appraisal and field development planning, completion, production/injection procedures, strategy technologies, water flooding, reservoir surveillance, SCAL, PVT, geochemical analysis and fluid compatibility. Additionally, expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and data analytics are desirable but not required.
  • Must have history of using modern reservoir management practices for oil reservoirs.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, our people work on truly world‑scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. We invest heavily in talent development and encourage continuous learning through extensive workforce development programs.

title: Senior Completion and Intervention Engineer
description:
This position is for a Well Completion Engineer, responsible for designing and planning well completions, coordinating interventions, and supporting execution activities to ensure safe and efficient well operations from preparation to final closeout.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by the Subsurface team.
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly budgets and well/project specific AFE's.
  • Forecast and be accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific long lead requirements.
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination and quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel.
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required.
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required, including conducting service quality meetings.
  • Ensure vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process to ensure timely action/close out.
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required.
  • Contribute to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS).
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, execution and closeout activities.
  • Ensure compliance with company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied materials, equipment and services, including review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required.
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process.
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings.
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and third-party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance.
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations.

Well/Project Specific Duties

  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team, including optimizing well planning, design, engineering, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities. Activities include performing offset reviews and well hazard identification.
  • Establish subsurface well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material and equipment selection.
  • Identify special engineering studies to be performed.
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required.
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and present a succinct recommendation.
  • Raise requisitions and purchase orders.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services, including review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Review all applicable operating, installing and testing procedures, including interface documents.
  • Assist with drilling-related engineering, mobilisation, installation and commissioning activities if/when required.
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP/IWOP's as part of well/project commencement.
  • Ensure the Well Barrier Schematic is current and valid for the current operation being performed.
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties.
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices.
  • Review the engineering-focused After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt.
  • Responsible for compilation of End of Well Reports (EOWRs).

Education

  • Degree in Engineering
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) – Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant Well Completion and Well Intervention engineering experience.
  • At least 5 years experience with operators in Brazil including IOCs.
  • Project experience on dry tree development(s) including exposure to conceptual and detailed design as well as execution of completions and well intervention operations.
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution.
  • Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) – Wellplan, WellCAT, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages.
  • Knowledge of Brazilian well integrity regulations SGIP/SGSO.
  • Familiarity with well testing and well clean-up activities is desirable.
  • Experience with subsea completion and intervention considered an advantage

Qualificações

Na CASSI somos movidos pelo propósito que é o de “Cuidar do participante em todas as fases da sua vida”, ainda que façamos parte de uma equipe de atividade meio ou fim, nosso propósito é único e sempre voltado ao participante da CASSI.

Precisamos de pessoas que estejam dispostas a aprender e multiplicar conhecimento, avaliar e trocar ideias sobre o processo com a ótica de que podemos estar em constantes mudanças e melhorias.

Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão!

  • Realizar assistência médica respeitando as premissas do Código de Ética Médica.
  • Exercer atribuições conforme a política da CASSI.
  • Realizar consulta e atendimento médico, por meio de anamnese, exame físico, solicitação e análise de exames complementares conforme estratégias, programas e diretrizes da CASSI.
  • Emitir diagnósticos e aplicar recursos de medicina terapêutica e preventiva aos participantes.
  • Efetuar e requisitar exames complementares de acordo com os protocolos estabelecidos e necessidade dos participantes.

  • Ser, quando indicado pela CASSI, o responsável técnico em sua área de atribuição, perante órgãos diversos.
  • Realizar atendimento de urgência e emergência, sempre que necessário, no âmbito da CliniCASSI.
  • Realizar interconsulta com outros profissionais de saúde, sempre que necessário.
  • Participar de programas e atividades de educação em saúde, articulado com equipe da APS, com vistas à melhoria da saúde do participante.

  • Realizar a notificação compulsória de doenças, sempre que necessário.
  • Participar de discussão de casos clínicos, sempre que necessário.
  • Participar de campanhas educativas nos campos da saúde pública e da medicina preventiva.
  • Prestar informações do processo saúde-doença aos participantes e a seus familiares.
  • Realizar diagnóstico da comunidade Cassi e levantar indicadores de saúde para avaliação do impacto das ações em saúde implementadas.
  • Orientar e zelar pela preservação e guarda dos equipamentos, aparelhos e instrumentais utilizados em sua especialidade, observando a sua correta utilização.
  • Utilizar equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI) conforme preconizado pela ANVISA.
  • Orientar os colaboradores que o auxiliam na execução das tarefas típicas do cargo.
  • Participar na elaboração do planejamento do serviço, seguindo as diretrizes da CASSI.

ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Realizar atendimento médico aos participantes na área de cardiologia, seguindo protocolos e diretrizes da Cassi.
  • Realizar suporte técnico (preceptoria, interconsulta discussão de caso e elaboração de protocolos) às equipes da APS na área de cardiologia.
  • Realizar diagnóstico e propor tratamento para doenças cardiovasculares e propor alternativas para melhoria de vida.
  • Realizar acompanhamento dos participantes com doenças cardiovasculares e propor alternativas para melhoria da qualidade de vida.
  • Realizar avaliação pré-cirúrgicas dos participantes.
  • Realizar encaminhamento externo conforme oferta e tipo de serviço previamente pactuado com a APS seguindo linhas de cuidado e respeitando o rol de cobertura do plano.
  • Referenciar primeiramente os profissionais da APS para quaisquer novos problemas de saúde identificados.

Caixa de Assistência dos Funcionários do Banco do Brasil

A CASSI foi fundada em 27 de janeiro de 1944 por um grupo de funcionários do BB, com o objetivo de ressarcir as despesas de saúde dessa população. Nestas oito décadas, a Empresa experimentou grande desenvolvimento, tornando-se uma das maiores instituições sem fins lucrativos administradoras de planos de saúde do País. As 27 Unidades, instaladas em todos os Estados do País, proporcionam atendimento acolhedor e diferenciado.

O diferencial da Caixa de Assistência está na proposta de atendimento integral, focado na promoção da saúde e na prevenção de doenças, por meio da Estratégia Saúde da Família. Assim, é pioneira entre os planos de saúde brasileiros na oferta de programas e atividades coletivas em saúde, voltados para melhoria dos hábitos de vida, nutrição, atividade física, realização de consultas periódicas e exames de rotina, além de proporcionar o acompanhamento adequado dos portadores de doenças crônicas.

title: Compliance Analyst
description:
About Crown

We exist to make money work better. That means eliminating the friction of integrating the Brazilian Real into the blockchain economy without sacrificing trust, safety, or compliance.

With the conviction that programmable money is the future of finance, we built BRLV . Anchored by a 1:1 backing of sovereign Brazilian treasury assets, BRLV is the safe, scalable settlement layer designed for the tokenized economy.

We’re backed by Framework, Valor, Norte, Coinbase Ventures, Paxos, and Nubank co‑founder Ed Wible. Our goal: R$1 trillion of BRLV in circulation within 10 years.

The Role

As a Compliance Analyst at Crown, you will be a cornerstone of our risk management framework, operating across both the first and second lines of defense. You will serve as the primary compliance liaison for our institutional clients and partners, guiding them through our rigorous due diligence process while performing critical risk analysis to protect the firm. This role requires a unique blend of client‑facing communication skills and deep analytical rigor. You will work directly with the Chief Compliance Officer and the broader risk function to implement and uphold our institutional‑grade AML/CFT Policy.

  • Institutional Onboarding (1st Line): Act as the main point of contact for institutional clients during the entire onboarding lifecycle. You will guide them through the appropriate Due Diligence Questionnaire (for Brazilian, U.S., or other non‑U.S. entities), ensuring all mandatory documentation—such as constitutional documents, AML/CFT policies, and ownership charts—is collected completely and accurately.
  • Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Risk Assessment (2nd Line): Conduct comprehensive reviews of prospective clients, applying our risk‑based approach. This includes analyzing complex corporate structures to identify and verify Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) according to our dynamic thresholds.
  • Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Execute enhanced due diligence for high‑risk clients, including Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), VASPs, and other financial institutions. This involves a critical assessment of the client’s own AML program, their independent audit reports, and the source of their funds and wealth.
  • Transaction Monitoring Support (2nd Line): Assist in the analysis of alerts generated by our on‑chain and fiat transaction monitoring systems. You will investigate atypical activity, adhering to strict internal SLAs for resolution (e.g., 24 hours for critical alerts), and prepare dossiers for potential Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to be submitted to COAF.
  • Record Keeping and Data Protection: Ensure all due diligence, risk assessments, and client communications are meticulously documented and securely stored, in compliance with our policies and regulatory requirements. You will handle highly sensitive client data and must adhere strictly to our Information Security Policy and data protection principles (LGPD).

You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You have 3+ years of experience in a compliance, KYC/AML, risk, or client onboarding role within a VASP, fintech, or regulated financial institution.
  • You have a deep and practical understanding of Brazilian AML/CFT regulations (e.g., Law 14.478/22, COAF reporting) and are familiar with international FATF standards.
  • You are fluent in both Portuguese and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills required to interact with sophisticated institutional clients and internal stakeholders.
  • You have a highly analytical mindset and an obsessive attention to detail, capable of dissecting complex legal and corporate structures to identify underlying risks.
  • You thrive in ownership-driven environments. You’re highly accountable for your work and don’t require others following up on it.
  • You naturally operate cross-functionally, with strong collaborative instincts toward legal, operations, and technology teams.
  • You are energized by the challenge of building and refining compliance processes from the ground up in a fast-paced environment.

What’s Different About Working Here

  • Small by design. We don’t hire layers of managers. Everyone builds.
  • Ownership is total. You own the function end‑to‑end—and ask for input when it makes the work better, not because someone’s checking.
  • Ruthlessly simple. We don’t paper over complexity with process or headcount.
  • Collaboration is default. Problems are shared property. We work across domains.
  • Feedback is candid and direct. Built on the assumption that everyone here is smart, competent, and cares.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary
  • Full health coverage
  • VA

title: Roaming IREG Engineer
description:
1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.

We're looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team

Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming)
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services)
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses — to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Technician, Platform Operations 1
description:
Technician, Platform Operations Rio

SES provides broadband platform solutions across a diverse range of satellite services, including aviation, maritime, cellular backhaul, and enterprise networking. As part of this role, the team member will be expected to support SES customers operating within these specialized environments and elevate issues to appropriate internal or external teams as needed. When required, this individual will coordinate and facilitate troubleshooting sessions involving SES customers, technology partners, and vendors to ensure timely resolution and service continuity.

The NOC Technician role is in a 24x7x365 office environment. This individual will be working in an operations environment responding to emails and answering phone calls to support satellite and IP‑based broadband platform offerings. The ideal candidate will be familiar with the demands and expectations of working in an operations center and will be knowledgeable of radio frequency (RF) and satellite broadband platforms technology.

This team member will be responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving service issues across a global network of terminals and will work closely with internal teams to ensure customer needs and external service levels are met.

The role is focused on supporting the SES customer base and requires strong communication skills, with a customer‑first mindset. This role also requires a candidate with written and verbal fluency in Portuguese, English, and Spanish.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

  • Support customer calls and requests in Portuguese, English and Spanish
  • Perform triage and troubleshooting of service interruptions, alarms, and performance issues across satellite and IP‑based platforms.
  • Monitor and manage full‑time services and teleport RF‑based hub equipment.
  • Stay up to date on new technology, tools and applications that are used to provide the assistance needed for customer requests
  • Must exhibit sense of urgency to complete customer requests in a timely manner and engage internal support teams to take over troubleshooting in the event of a customer impacting issue

title: Fund Accountant, Implementations
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You\u2019ll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY
  • $96,900 - $114,000 in Seattle, WA

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain. Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. For more information about this type of scam, please review the guidelines provided by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately to

Awards and Acknowledgements

Companies and funds like Tribe and Pipe build their businesses on Carta. The company has been included on the Forbes World’s Best Cloud Companies, Fast Company\u2019s Most Innovative list, and Inc.’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies. We’ve also been recognized as a 2023 Built In Best Place to Work in the U.S., a Muse VIBE Award winner in the Vacation and Time Off category and certified as a Great Place to Work.

Sobre nós
Somos orgulhosamente brasileiros e populares, digitais sempre e presenciais quando o cliente quiser. Inovamos para dar acesso a serviços financeiros e oferecemos uma experiência que encoraja as pessoas a vencerem o hoje. Nossa razão de existir é clara: lutar por uma experiência bancária que acolhe e encoraja todos os brasileiros. E fazemos isso com disponibilidade, acolhimento e agilidade.

Nossa cultura, O Jeito Agi

Viver pelo cliente
Nosso principal ativo são os clientes. A empresa só existe se conseguir resolver suas dores, entregando produtos e experiências melhores que alternativas disponíveis no mercado.

Agir como empreendedor
Quantas empresas você conhece que cobram espírito de dono do time? Muitas, né? Mas quantas delas possibilitam que as pessoas sejam de fato donas? No Agibank é assim, então aqui você age como dono porque já é dono ou porque sonha em ser o próximo.

Crescer na jornada
Nossa cultura é forte. Então, só faz sentido empreender aqui caso você se identifique muito com ela. Se você é uma pessoa fanática por resultado, tem pavor de zona de conforto, vive em eterna busca por conhecimento, prefere as coisas ditas direto ao ponto e quer estar rodeada de pessoas que também são assim, você vai curtir muito sua jornada aqui.

Seus desafios para crescer na jornada

  • Dominar o portfólio de produtos do Agibank.
  • Prospectar novos clientes através de ações externas, telemarketing ativo, atendimento via mídias sociais, indicações, parcerias, conversão de oportunidades, conversão de leads gerados e atendimento presencial em loja.

  • Validar oportunidades, registrar em sistema e ser responsável por todo andamento e qualidade da carteira, retendo o cliente e revertendo possíveis perdas.
  • Identificar e solucionar possíveis problemas relacionados a contratos.

O que você precisa para se tornar um Agilizado?

Requisitos

  • Ensino Médio completo
  • Conhecimento básico do pacote Office
  • Certificação de Correspondente Bancário para ofertar produtos de Crédito Consignado (FEBRABAN, ANEPS, entre outras), indispensável pra o exercício da atividade.

Diferenciais

  • Ensino superior em andamento

Benefícios e facilidades

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, teleatendimento psicológico e médico gratuito, Totalpass, vale-refeição e alimentação e seguro de vida/auxílio-funeral.

Programa Tô de dono
O Tô de Dono é mais do que um programa de incentivo a longo prazo – ele é o reconhecimento de quem vive diariamente a nossa cultura. A cada ano, o Programa tem novos participantes, colaboradores que se tornam donos do negócio e ganham com a valorização do Agibank sempre que a empresa cresce. Então, quem faz parte dessa história é quem mergulha de cabeça nos desafios para entregar grandes resultados. É assim que construímos, verdadeiramente, uma cultura de donos. The Operations Support Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring a seamless learning experience by providing comprehensive support to our contracted tutors and students. At Nerdy (NYSE: NRDY) - the company behind Varsity Tutors - we’re redrawing the blueprint of learning. Our Live + AI™ platform fuses real‑time human expertise with proprietary generative‑AI systems, setting a new bar for measurable academic impact at global scale.

In an era where great employees can deliver 10‑times the leverage of the merely good, we back those who play to win.

Fortune favors the bold. Join us.

  • AI‑Native at every level From the CEO to day‑one hires, everyone builds and ships with generative AI. If you’re not wielding AI, you’re not done.

If you’re a technically minded builder who thrives on open competition, personal responsibility, and the chance to redefine how the world learns – while continually stretching the limits of what generative AI can do – come do the most ambitious and rewarding work of your career here.

Learn more atnerdy.com .

Nerdy’s shareholder letters below explain our latest products and strategy:

  • Provide Insights for School System Partners:
  • Address and resolve complaints, offering appropriate solutions and alternatives.
  • Evaluate quality inputs such as compliance with client‑defined requirements, tutor preparedness, and platform ease of use.

  • Prior experience in a customer service contact center, handling inbound calls, chats, emails, or workloads.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace (formerly Google documents).
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • A solutions‑based mindset, consistently seeking effective resolutions for end users.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to work independently as a self‑starter.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to multitask effectively in a dynamic environment with quickly changing priorities.
  • Willingness and ability to quickly learn business practices, policies, and procedures.
  • A commitment to going above and beyond to ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Ability to demonstrate empathy and understanding when interacting with end users.
  • Comfortable performing all job responsibilities on a laptop or computer.

  • Reliable high‑speed internet access (100 Mbps download, 25 Mbps upload) via wired ethernet connection (no Wi‑Fi, Satellite, or Cellular Hotspot/Internet).

Preferred Qualifications:

Work Schedule

title: Operations Analyst
description:
About Crown

We exist to make money work better. That means eliminating the friction of integrating the Brazilian Real into the blockchain economy without sacrificing trust, safety, or compliance.

With the conviction that programmable money is the future of finance, we built BRLV . Anchored by a 1:1 backing of sovereign Brazilian treasury assets, BRLV is the safe, scalable settlement layer designed for the tokenized economy.

We’re backed by Framework, Valor, Norte, Coinbase Ventures, Paxos, and Nubank co‑founder Ed Wible. Our goal: R$1 trillion of BRLV in circulation within 10 years.

Role

As an Operations Analyst at Crown, you will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of all onboarded clients activity. You will be in charge of the transaction lifecycle, from minting and redemption of stablecoins to managing client support, responding to operational inquiries.

This role demands meticulous attention to detail, adherence to strict security protocols, and a process‑driven mindset to ensure the integrity of our operations. You will work at the intersection of technology, finance, and compliance, collaborating closely with all teams to maintain a best‑in‑class operational framework.

Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Governance and Execution: Manage and monitor all client virtual asset transactions using our institutional custody platform. Apply our Transaction Policy Engine rules, which include requiring multi‑party approval for high‑value withdrawals and blocking transfers to non‑whitelisted addresses.
  • Fiat and Crypto Operations: Oversee the daily flow of mint and redeem orders. Process BRL deposits and withdrawals while ensuring strict adherence to our rules, as well as executing the corresponding on‑chain token movements.
  • Daily Reconciliation: Perform daily reconciliation of the on‑chain token supply against the funds held in our segregated reserve accounts to ensure our stablecoins remain fully backed 1:1 at all times.
  • Client Operations Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for institutional clients regarding all post‑onboarding operational matters, including transaction status inquiries, settlement confirmations, and troubleshooting deposit or withdrawal issues.
  • Alert Management: Act as the first responder for operational alerts, such as failed transactions or transactions blocked by our policy engine. Investigate the root cause, resolve the issue, and communicate with the client as needed.
  • Process Improvement: Identify operational bottlenecks, inefficiencies, or control gaps in our daily workflows and collaborate with the technology and compliance teams to design and implement improvements.

You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You have 3+ years of experience in a financial operations, treasury operations, payments, or "back office" role, preferably at a VASP, fintech, or regulated financial institution.
  • You are exceptionally detail‑oriented and process‑driven. In this role, precision is paramount, and you must be comfortable following complex procedures without deviation.
  • You have a foundational understanding of blockchain technology, including concepts like wallets, addresses, and transaction lifecycles.
  • You are fluent in both Portuguese and English and able to communicate clearly and professionally with sophisticated institutional clients about technical operational matters.
  • You are a resilient and emotionally intelligent professional, able to keep perfect task execution even under pressure, especially when handling high‑value transactions.
  • You thrive in ownership‑driven environments. You're highly accountable for your work and don't require others following up on it.
  • You are naturally collaborative and can work effectively with Compliance (escalating suspicious activity), Treasury (managing liquidity), and Technology (reporting system issues) teams.

What’s Different About Working Here

  • Small by design. We don’t hire layers of managers. Everyone builds.
  • Ownership is total. You own the function end‑to‑end—and ask for input when it makes the work better, not because someone’s checking.
  • Ruthlessly simple. We don’t paper over complexity with process or headcount.
  • Collaboration is default. Problems are shared property. We work across domains.
  • Feedback is candid and direct. Built on the assumption that everyone here is smart, competent, and cares.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary
  • Full health coverage
  • VA

  • Mid‑Senior level

Employment Type

  • Full‑time

Job Function

  • Management and Manufacturing

Industries

Job Overview

The Principal Cost Controls Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices to improve cost and schedule. They will be tasked with solving complex cost management problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Cost Controls Specialist may be required to guide junior personnel. As such, they must have in-depth expertise in costing and broad knowledge of the costing discipline within the project controls function.

Responsibilities

  • Implement McDermott processes and systems on projects.
  • Lead the project controls team on large and highly complex EPC projects.
  • Implement constructability concepts, (the how it’s built) and related interdependencies between Engineering, Procurement, Fabrication, and Construction in support of the Advanced Work Planning (AWP) process.
  • Support the development of the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) on complex projects with multiple partners and compensation types.
  • Implement internal and contractual requirements on the project via the project controls execution plan.
  • Lead setup and implementation of project controls systems.
  • Responsible for the accuracy of project controls reports.
  • Analyze and interpret cost forecasting and trending.
  • Recommends solutions or recovery plans for problem areas.
  • Lead preparation and review of the project monthly forecast.
  • Support the Project Controls Team in development of the cost spread and cash flows.
  • Participate in proposal development, commercial alignment and project kickoff processes.
  • Supervise and train junior personnel in all aspects of cost reporting.
  • Lead the set up and maintenance of the progress measurement system.
  • Implement and support the Change Management process.
  • Lead change management efforts, including building of cost estimates and apply or manage amendments to the contract.
  • Lead project reviews conducted with the client and internal management.
  • Support the development and implementation of the Project Risk and Opportunity process.
  • Participate or lead the weekly and monthly cost and schedule review meetings.
  • Manage and maintain good client relations.
  • Actively look for areas of improvement on project and company standards.
  • Create Weekly / Monthly / Quarterly Reports.
  • Assist in resource planning, recruiting, mentoring, and evaluations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or Construction Management is preferred or
  • Ten plus (10+) years of experience in Project Controls.
  • Must have experience in a large-scale mega-project in Oil & Gas and Offshore Construction.
  • Highly competent in the use of critical project management concepts such as EVM, project planning, risk analysis, and progress measurement).
  • Experienced in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Project Management Professional is a plus.
  • Understanding of Cost and Progress management systems is a plus Work independently with little or no supervision.
  • Great communication and presentation skills, both written and spoken.
  • Experienced in both Cost and Schedule with a focus on Cost Management.
  • Understand the relationship between estimating, cost management, progress, schedule, and project accounting.

About Us

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

title: [2025] - BR Analista de Importação Sr - L'Oréal Supply Chain
description:
A L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a “Criar a beleza que move o mundo”; é agora a líder mundial da indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza; onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo.

Missão

Venha fazer parte do grandioso time de Operações com 21k colaboradores, onde você irá enfrentar desafios complexos e estará na linha de frente da construção de uma beleza sustentável junto com nossos parceiros de negócios. Nesse time você terá a importante missão de desenvolver, desenhar, pesquisar, fabricar e entregar produtos e serviços para o mundo todo!

Principais Atividades

  • Gestão de Operações de Importação (End-to-End): Gerenciar e coordenar integralmente todas as etapas dos processos de importação, desde a prontidão inicial com fornecedores internacionais até a entrega final da mercadoria, assegurando a conformidade e a eficiência operacional.
  • Gestão Estratégica de Fornecedores: Administrar o relacionamento e a performance de parceiros logísticos, como Trading Companies e Agentes de Carga, negociando condições, monitorando o cumprimento de SLAs e otimizar a cadeia de logística.
  • Visibilidade e Monitoramento em Tempo Real:Implementar e gerenciar ferramentas para proporcionar visibilidade em tempo real do status dos embarques, fornecendo informações críticas de forma proativa às equipes de Planejamento e Operador Logístico (3PLs).
  • Liderança e Execução de Automação de Processos: Identificar, propor e implementar soluções de automação para otimizar fluxos de trabalho da importação, reduzir erros manuais e aumentar a eficiência operacional.
  • Comunicação e Colaboração Estratégica:Interagir proativamente com as diversas partes interessadas (stakeholders) internas e externos, garantindo um fluxo de comunicação eficaz e transparente para o alinhamento de toda a cadeia de planejamento.

Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Comércio Exterior e Operações de Importação: Profundo conhecimento em toda a rotina de importação, incluindo Incoterms, etapas de desembaraço aduaneiro, custos logísticos e peculiaridades de diferentes modais (marítimo & aéreo).
  • Legislação Aduaneira e Regulatórias: Sólida compreensão da legislação aduaneira brasileira e demais regulamentações pertinentes, com ênfase em processos específicos da ANVISA (Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária) para produtos importados.
  • Planejamento de Supply Chain: Habilidade em planejamento logístico, com capacidade de integrar as operações de importação ao planejamento estratégico da empresa.
  • Análise de Dados e Business Intelligence: Domínio de ferramentas como Power BI eExcel Avançado para análise de dados, criação de relatórios e dashboards gerenciais.
  • Possibilidades de crescimentos, incluindo carreira internacional;
  • Cultura voltada para pessoas, pessoas e pessoas!

Estamos empenhados em garantir processos de recrutamento inclusivos e em defender a contratação e promoção de cada candidato de forma ética e equitativa.

O Grupo proíbe estritamente a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião ou quaisquer outras características protegidas por lei.

Sobre a Ocyan

Somos uma fornecedora do setor de óleo e gás e novas energias com grande expertise e excelência técnica. Main responsibilities

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

1. Apoiar no cumprimento dos requisitos legais, normativos e contratuais relacionados à segurança do trabalho, saúde e meio ambiente, contribuindo para a conformidade das atividades exercidas com a legislação vigente;

2. Monitorar e reportar riscos ocupacionais, apoiando na elaboração e revisão de análises preliminares de risco (APRs) e procedimentos de SMS, sempre alinhado às diretrizes da equipe de riscos corporativa;

3. Participar de investigações de incidentes e não conformidades, apoiando a coleta de evidências, consolidação das análises e elaboração de relatórios, visando identificar causas e propor recomendações de melhoria;

5. Acompanhar planos de ação de SMS, monitorando prazos, consolidando resultados e apoiando as áreas na implementação das medidas corretivas e preventivas;

6. Apoiar auditorias internas e externas de SMS, organizando evidências, registros e acompanhando a tratativa das não conformidades;

7. Elaborar materiais, relatórios e campanhas da área, apoiando na divulgação de práticas preventivas, programas de engajamento e treinamentos junto às equipes;

8. Contribuir para a gestão de requisitos ambientais, incluindo o acompanhamento de processos de resíduos, efluentes e relatórios periódicos;

9. Registrar e compartilhar lições aprendidas e boas práticas associadas as atividades exercidas, promovendo a melhoria contínua dentro da equipe e da organização;

10. Orientar e apoiar o desenvolvimento da equipe, promovendo a transferência de conhecimento técnico e a disseminação de boas práticas operacionais, garantindo que a equipe esteja alinhada com os objetivos da companhia;

11. Realizar embarques, quando solicitado, com foco no acompanhamento e compreensão dos processos operacionais, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e apoiando a análise de conformidade com requisitos normativos e de segurança – se aplicável;

1. Ensino Superior concluído em áreas correlatas e/ou Engenharia (preferencialmente Ambiental, Mecânica, Produção ou Química);

2. Formação técnica em Segurança do Trabalho (desejável caso não haja ensino superior em Engenharia);

TREINAMENTOS/CERTIFICAÇÕES/REGISTROS:

1. Certificações como ISO 45001/14001/9001 são consideradas desejáveis;

COMPETÊNCIAS:

1. Alta capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica;

2. Experiência mínima de 3 a 5 anos, preferencialmente no setor de óleo e gás/energia;

3. Experiência prévia em liderança de equipes, preferencialmente com equipes multidisciplinares (desejável);

5. Conhecimento das Normas Regulamentadoras aplicáveis;

6. Conhecimento avançado em metodologias de investigação de incidentes (desejável);

8. Inglês avançado;

A L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, a L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a “criar a beleza que move o mundo”; é agora a líder mundial da indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza; onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo.

Na L’Oréal Grande Público, nossa missão é democratizar o melhor da beleza, que significa levar a beleza para todos. E para nós, a beleza deve ser sustentável. A Divisão de Grande Público porta a marca número 1 de beleza no mundo com L'Oréal Paris, a marca número 1 de maquiagem com Maybelline New York e a marca natural número 1 com Garnier. A L’Oréal Grande Público é a maior divisão do grupo L'Oréal, com mais de 30mil colaboradores ao redor do mundo.

A área Comercial da L'Oréal é uma verdadeira força motriz por trás do sucesso das nossas marcas e clientes! A nossa equipe comercial é composta por profissionais estratégicos, analíticos, criativos e orientados para resultados, que trabalham em parceria com nossos clientes para impulsionar o crescimento dos negócios. Além disso, você terá a chance de trabalhar com os produtos mais inovadores e desejados do mercado de beleza. Junte-se a nós e faça parte dessa jornada incrível, onde você terá a oportunidade de deixar a sua marca no mundo da beleza!

Missão

Impulsionar o crescimento das marcas de Skincare da L'Oréal Grande Público por meio de diagnósticos e insights data driven, desenvolvimento de planos comerciais e forte cooperação com os times de marketing, comercial e merchandising.

Principais Atividades

  • Responsável pelas análises de performance, como sell in, sell out, DOH e distribuição para as marcas de L’Oreal Paris Skin e Garnier para a tomada de decisões estratégicas
  • Desenvolvimento, gestão da verba e acompanhamento das execuções dos materiais de visibilidade junto ao time de merchandising, retroalimentando a cadeia com aprendizados e boas práticas
  • Garantir o desdobramento dos planos estratégicos da marca junto as interfaces (principalmente canais) e fazer o acompanhamento constante dos resultados através de dados
  • Responsável pela liderança e atualização das reuniões comerciais e com marketing
  • Análise post mortem das ações de trade implementadas e alinhamentos com o time de marketing para garantir as melhores estratégias
  • Construção de materiais para caminhos estratégicos baseado em dados internos e de mercado
  • Preparação de selling story e materiais para reuniões de JBP e de construção de planos com clientes.
  • Gestão do jovem aprendiz da área

Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Perfil analítico com espírito empreendedor e proativo, visão estratégica do negócio e ágil para aprender e gerenciar tomadas de decisões mais complexas
  • Facilidade e experiência em trabalhar com análise de dados e diferentes ferramentas (IQVIA, Nielsen, Power BI, Excel, entre outras).
  • Organização, planejamento e gestão eficiente do tempo;
  • Capacidade para trabalhar de forma independente e eficiente;
  • Habilidade em construir relações sólidas com diversas áreas do negócio;

O Que Você Vai Encontrar

  • Possibilidades de crescimentos, incluindo carreira internacional;
  • Ambiente inclusivo e diverso;
  • Cultura voltada para pessoas, pessoas e pessoas!

Estamos empenhados em garantir processos de recrutamento inclusivos e em defender a contratação e promoção de cada candidato de forma ética e equitativa.

O Grupo proíbe estritamente a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião ou quaisquer outras características protegidas por lei.

Temos orgulho de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais.

Descrição da vaga

#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL! Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores: Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente. Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros. Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Quais serão seus desafios:

  • Desenho e implementação dos produtos a serem comercializados em todos os canais da empresa;
  • Manutenção dos produtos em relação a legislação e posicionamento de mercado;
  • Apoio a equipe de gerenciamento de projeto na implementação dos produtos, seu lançamento e acompanhamento pós lançamento;
  • Acompanhamento dos resultados dos produtos, em conjunto com a área Técnica, com o objetivo de promover alterações que garantam a sustentabilidade financeira e competitividade;
  • Apoio na manutenção das informações e análises sobre a concorrência, com o objetivo de avaliar a competitividade dos produtos da empresa;
  • Treinamento e apoio à equipe comercial na capacitação e atividade de prospecção de distribuidores.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você:

  • Superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Economia, Engenharia de Produção, Ciências Atuariais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência anterior na área de produtos, preferencialmente em empresas do mercado financeiro ou segurador;
  • Perfil organizado, voltado para resultados, com bom relacionamento interpessoal e capacidade analítica;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida, presencialmente de 4 a 8 vezes por mês no Centro do Rio de Janeiro. Caso seja colaborador(a) da MAG e resida fora do Rio, a atuação deverá ocorrer em unidade da MAG mais próxima à residência, na mesma frequência.

Será um diferencial se você possuir:

  • Experiência em projetos com implementação em modelo ágil;
  • Excel avançado e noções de programação;
  • Experiência anterior com seguros de vida e previdência privada.

Somos a MAG!

title: Systems Engineer - Tendering & FEED
description:
Lead Subsea Systems Engineer (Front-End Engineering)

Are you a Systems Engineer looking for an interesting and inspiring opportunity? Are you passionate about Front End Engineering and Development Studies? Join our innovating Engineering team! Bringing cutting-edge physical and digital technologies together to create subsea systems – the beating heart of our work. Devising smarter systems that control and monitor oil and gas extraction, our subsea products and flexible pipe capabilities are industry leading. Our team provides support for customer operations to ensure continuity for production.

Partner with the best

You will be challenged to lead Front End Engineering & Development studies, giving support to projects and technology development at a system coordination level. You will also support execution of subsea projects, support regional sales and commercial teams, and interact with customers providing technical expertise during early engagement activities.

Responsibilities

  • Executing system design to proposals and projects.
  • Reporting progress, technical and interface matters in project meetings and progress reports of assigned tasks and CTRs.
  • Defining system layout from concept definition phase to FEED, detail engineering and execution phases of a subsea project.
  • Defining and preparing functional specifications for subsea system building blocks such as trees, controls, wellhead connections, manifolds, and flowlines.
  • Acting or supporting the study manager with technical interface, change control, technical variations, and general delivery of the scope.
  • Providing system design input to large subsea project proposals and equipment contracts.
  • Liaising with clients on a technical level to ensure their needs are met and ensuring they are aware of data-input requirements to allow the study to proceed on-schedule.
  • Supporting the OFE sales and commercial organization in identifying and pursuing opportunities related to early engagement or invitations to tender.
  • Assisting in the preparation of proposals as part of a proposals team or technical peer checker.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a MSc or BSc degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Controls Engineering or equivalent with extensive experience in a similar role.
  • Have broad knowledge of processes, methods and procedures within project and engineering management.
  • Have proven experience in front-end design activities, covering concept, pre-FEED and FEED studies.
  • Have proven experience in design and selection across one or more of the following: field architecture, flow assurance, system analysis, interface management, requirement management, process engineering, subsea production systems, risers, flowlines and pipelines, control systems, constructability and installation.
  • Have demonstrable depth of experience in project engineering within a multi-disciplinary environment.
  • Be available to travel internationally for project needs and for short-term assignments.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours – flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities.
  • Comprehensive private medical care options.
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs.
  • Tailored financial programs.
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits.

About Us

With operations in over 120 countries, we provide better solutions for our customers and richer opportunities for our people. As a leading partner to the energy industry, we’re committed to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 and we’re always looking for the right people to help us get there. People who are as passionate as we are about making energy safer, cleaner and more efficient.

Join Us

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company with a global reach and exciting services and clients? Come join us and grow with a team of people who will energize and inspire you!

Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

About Us

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Join Us

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

  • Ensure collaboration with stakeholders teams to improve operational productivity (marketing, S&Ops, HR, legal, procurement).

Role Qualifications

  • 4 - 5 years of experience in sales B2B/B2C, fuel market, food delivery, strategy consulting or other professional services with a proven track record in using data to drive business decisions.
  • Great ability of negotiation and relationship.
  • Availability for business travels around twice a month.
  • Experience in team management.
  • Proven to be self-motivated, self-directed, and eager to take ownership of tasks to ensure solutions.
  • Intermediate English knowledge: the position may requires eventual interaction with international stakeholders living in Brazil and abroad.
  • Distinctive problem-solving - ability to break down ambiguous problems, put structure and use data-driven insights to solve them.
  • Clear Communicator - you are a clear and concise communicator with the ability to synthesise a lot of information quickly and highlight the key insights.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software tools and working in a business with constant changes.

EEO Statement

  • Geramos Valor para os Usuários - Existimos para fazer o melhor para os nossos usuários e inovamos para estarmos sempre na frente. Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar.

  • Somos Donos e Focados nos Resultados - Vamos além dos interesses pessoais para focar no que é melhor para a DiDi. Sempre cumprimos o que prometemos e buscamos a excelência na execução, estabelecendo uma barra alta e dando o nosso máximo em tudo que fazemos.
  • Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Temos a mente aberta e sempre remamos com respeito, empatia e confiança uns nos outros. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos.
  • Somos Íntegros - Integridade é a nossa base e a linha que nunca ultrapassamos. Comunicamos com honestidade, transparência e ouvimos a voz de todos para sempre fazer o que é certo.
  • Desenvolvemos uns aos Outros - Nosso crescimento vem da constante aventura de estarmos fora da nossa zona de conforto. Aceitamos desafios, nos superamos e trabalhamos em busca da excelência em tudo que fazemos. Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra.
  • Trabalhamos com Paixão & Diversão - Somos completamente apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Mantemos um espírito leve e otimista, contagiando o nosso ambiente com energia positiva. Somos resilientes, não temos medo de enfrentar desafios e sempre celebramos nossa sucesso.
  • Vivemos a Diversidade - Para nós, o coração da diversidade é a inclusão, a igualdade e o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove um ambiente mais criativo e cheio de energia, por isso, celebramos as diferenças e aqui todos podem ser quem são.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Diversidade não é uma visão de futuro ou desejo de algo que queremos um dia, é um valor inegociável de quem somos hoje.

Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres e 99Famílias.

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

Empresa familiar e independente, controla verticalmente todas as etapas de produção de suas coleções, desde a concepção artística e da busca das melhores gemas e metais preciosos até o lançamento em suas lojas e em campanhas publicitárias de alcance internacional.

Lançamentos constantes com temas inusitados e design único, campanhas publicitárias com estrelas internacionais, peças escolhidas por divas de Hollywood e parcerias criativas com personalidades artísticas refletem o DNA inovador da marca.

Todas as joias HStern são criadas e desenvolvidas em oficinas próprias de ourivesaria localizadas no Brasil, pelas mãos de experientes artesãos, muitos deles criados na casa onde desenvolvem sua arte há décadas.

O edifício-sede da empresa, localizado em Ipanema, Rio de Janeiro, foi o primeiro prédio já planejado para hospedar todas as áreas envolvidas em manufatura e varejo de joias finas: ateliês de ouriversaria e lapidação, laboratórios de análise, instalações de treinamento, escritórios, showrooms e muito mais.

A empresa conta com um grupo global quase 2.000 colaboradores e está presente em mais de 10 países com 150 pontos de venda nas principais capitais do mundo como Nova York, Paris, Londres, Moscou, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Buenos Aires, Lima, Frankfurt e Tel Aviv.

Fundada no Rio de Janeiro, em 1945, pelo imigrante alemão Hans Stern ), hoje a marca está sob o comando de Roberto Stern, seu filho mais velho e atual Presidente e Diretor Criativo da empresa.

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro, uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
  • Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar!
